title: Respond to a click
summary: The on method adds an event handler. It can run a function whenever the chosen element receives that event.
introduction: The on method adds an event handler. It can run a function whenever the chosen element receives that event. Your task: Change the button reply.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for respond to a click

blocks.text: The on method adds an event handler. It can run a function whenever the chosen element receives that event.
Use a local HTML page that loads jQuery 3.7 before these scripts. Examples need that library; the plain playground does not include it. Put the script after the example markup.
Read the code step by step

items: The on call names the click event to wait for.
The arrow function changes the reply only after that event occurs.

blocks.text: The button fills the reply paragraph after a click.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Pass a function to on. Calling the function while attaching the handler would run it too soon.
